page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with marginal line numbers (5 to 35) down the left margin. Running head "BIBLICUS" at top centre, page number 293 at top right. At the foot, a signature "T 3" at left and a catchword "Gen.1." at right.

p.i: albus, & qui insidebat ei, vocabatur Fidelis & Verax, & qui iu-ste iudicat & pugnat.

main_text.p: 17. Deus est summè bonus, clemens, & misericors.
5Exod.34.v.6.7. Iehoua transiens ante faciem Mosis inclamauit: Iehoua, Iehoua, Deus misericors & gratiosus, longanimis, & multus benignitate ac fide: custodiens benignitatem millibus &c.
Psal.80.v.15. Tu Domine, Deus misericors & gratiosus es.
10Et v.13. Vt miseretur pater filiorum, miseretur Iehoua timentium ipsum. Confer Malach.3.v.16.
Psal.149.v.5. Bonus est Iehoua omnibus: & miserationes eius sunt in omnibus operibus eius.
Marc.10.v.18. Nemo bonus nisi vnus nempe Deus.
15Rom.2.v.4. An diuitias benignitatis eius, & tolerantiæ, & lenitatis contemnis?
Esa.42.v.8. Ego sum Dominus, illud est nomen meum, & gloriam meam alteri non dabo, & laudem meam sculptilibus.

20Dan.7.v.9.10. Videbam, donec sedes positæ sunt, & antiquus dierum sedit: cuius vestimentum, vt nix, album erat, & pili capitis vt lana munda, solium vt scintillæ ignis, rotæ vt ignis ardens: à cuius conspectu fluuius ignis manabat prodiens: cui millies mille ministrabant, & coram quo myrias myriadum stabant, dolnec, iudicio considente, libri aperti sunt.
Psal.104.v.1. Benedic anima mea Domino: Domine, Deus meus, magnus es valde; decorem & maiestatem induisti.
Act.7.v.2. Deus ille gloriæ visus est patri nostro Abrahamo.
1.Tim.1.v.11. Secundum euangelium beati Dei. Confer 30cap.6.v.15. & Iud.v.24.25.
19. Tres sunt personæ in vnâ essentiâ Dei.
1.Ioh.5.v.5. Tres sunt qui testificantur in cœlo: Pater, Sermo, & Spiritus sanctus: & hi tres vnum sunt.
35Matth.28.verf.19. Profecti docete omnes gentes: baptizantes eos in nomen Patris & Filij & Spiritus sancti. Confer Matth.3.

page.notes: The marginal numbers 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30 and 35 are line references in the left margin; they are transcribed as notes at the lines they stand beside. The number 25 sits beside "nec, iudicio confidente" and is placed at the start of that line's paragraph, as the printed margin shows. Some words in the Daniel passage are set in small or italic type and were read with some uncertainty, notably "donec sedes positæ sunt" (the printed text reads "donec solia abiecta sunt" and is copied as printed, see below). Printed text "donec solia abiecta sunt" is the actual reading; the transcription above contains a mistake in that phrase and should be checked against the scan. Reading "1.Ioh.5.v.5." and "Matth.28.verf.19." follow the print.
